text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Undergraduate certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of Undergraduate school 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents
